llvm.config: LLVM 23 development headers, opt, llvm-extract and lli from the same package family

alive2.linkage: LLVM component libraries linked statically; one Z3 5.3.1 runtime

notes: The Alive2 patch adapts APIs and omits LLVM-24-only IR enum entries absent in LLVM 23. It makes no claim of an upstream-accepted change.
The Z3 wheel omits z3_version.h. A version-only header was generated from the installed solver version for CMake discovery.
LLVM CMake import paths were relocated to the local tool prefix; this packaging adjustment is not a change to LLVM source.
The compatibility patch accepts an explicit version label when building a checksum-verified source archive without git metadata.
